reading.title: NASA to Help Unlock Mysteries of Mars’ Moons in Upcoming Mission
reading.summary: NASA is playing an important role in JAXA’s (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency) MMX (Martian Moons eXploration) mission, to advance our understanding of Mars’ moons and build on the agency’s long history of exploring the Red Planet. news.title: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,000 arrested after protests
news.summary: Disorder broke out in cities across the country on a day in which more than half a million joined cost of living protests.
